landing.appDescription: Video creation and editing platform powered by
landing.appDescription3: Automatically create Reels and personalized subtitles from your videos. With Vireel, transform your long content into ready-to-publish videos in minutes.
landing.feature1Desc: Transform your long videos into ready-to-share Reels. Vireel adapts your videos to vertical format, crops sequences, and allows you to add personalized subtitles to quickly create short and engaging content.
landing.feature2Desc: Transform your videos with automatically generated captions, perfectly synchronized with your content. Customize their style, appearance, and position to create more dynamic, accessible, and engaging videos.
landing.feature3Desc: Translate and dub your video audio into multiple languages while maintaining a natural voice faithful to the original speaker. Easily adapt your content to new markets and reach a wider audience, wherever they are.
landing.feature4Desc: Add catchy text overlays with custom fonts and styles. Highlight important information in your content with impactful titles that grab attention and enhance the impact of your Reels.
landing.feature5Desc: Give your videos a new dimension with professional visual effects. Adjust the appearance of your content with visual enhancements, transitions, and tailored settings to create more dynamic and engaging Reels.
landing.feature6Desc: Easily export your finalized Reels in formats optimized for TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, and YouTube. Manage your creations from your Vireel workspace and find your videos effortlessly, ready to be shared on your favorite platforms.
landing.stepDescription: With Vireel, transform a long video into short and engaging content in a few steps. Import your video or simply use a YouTube link, then let Vireel help you create, customize, and share your content.
landing.step1: Import your video or paste a YouTube link
landing.step1Desc: Start with a video you already have on your device or paste a YouTube link directly. Vireel supports your existing content and transforms it in just a few clicks.
landing.step2: Create your viral Reels with AI
landing.step2Desc: Let AI analyze your video to identify the most interesting moments and automatically generate multiple short clips. Each clip can then be adjusted and customized before being shared.
landing.step3Desc: With the subtitle generator, generate synchronized subtitles for your videos. Customize their appearance with different styles, fonts, sizes, and colors, and adapt the text to your audience through translation.
landing.step4Desc: Enhance your content with features designed for short-form videos: smart gaze tracking, AI video effects, and style customization. Adjust each creation to achieve the desired result.
landing.step5Desc: Refine your clips and subtitles directly in Vireel, then share your creations on your social networks. From the first selection to the final content, everything is gathered in one place.
landing.priceDesc: Choose the plan that matches your content volume. Each Vireel plan gives you access to reels and subtitles, with more credits and storage to support your growth.
landing.viral: Detection of viral moments via AI
landing.watermark: No Vireel watermark on generated videos
landing.vireelWhoDesc: Content creators, entrepreneurs, and teams use Vireel to transform their videos into short-form content faster. Whether you want to create multiple clips from a long video or add professional subtitles to your content, Vireel helps you create, customize, and share more efficiently.
landing.contentCreatorsDesc: Turn your long videos into multiple short clips suitable for social formats. Vireel analyzes your content to identify the most relevant moments, then allows you to customize each clip before sharing it on your preferred platforms.
landing.socialManagersDesc: Produce more short-form content for multiple brands or clients without multiplying tools. Vireel allows you to transform your videos, customize your clips and subtitles, and then share your creations directly on your social networks from a single space.
landing.podcastersEducatorsDesc: Turn your podcast episodes, training sessions, and educational content into short, engaging clips. Vireel analyzes your videos to identify the most interesting moments, then allows you to customize each clip before sharing it on your social networks.
landing.faqDesc: Find answers to the most common questions about Vireel, its features, subscriptions, and creating your video content.
landing.faq1: What is Vireel and how does it work?
landing.faq1Desc:
Vireel is a video creation platform that helps you transform your long-form videos into short-form content tailored for social media. Import a video or paste a YouTube link, then use Reels to automatically identify the most interesting moments and create short clips.

With Subtitles, add synchronized subtitles to your videos, customize their style, translate their text, and enhance their rendering with various customization options and effects. Once your creations are finalized, you can share them directly on your social media channels.
landing.faq2Desc:
Vireel offers three subscription plans: Silver, Gold, and Ultimate. Each plan provides access to Vireel's core features, including Reel creation and subtitle generation, with credit and storage levels tailored to different creation needs.

Choosing a plan depends primarily on your production volume. You can choose Silver to get started, then upgrade to a higher plan when you need more credits, storage, or creation capacity.

The details and limits of each plan are presented on our pricing page so you can choose the subscription best suited to your usage.
landing.faq3: How does Vireel compare to Submagic?
landing.faq3Desc:
Vireel and Submagic both offer tools to transform videos into short-form content tailored for social media. Vireel stands out with an approach centered on two essential needs: Reel creation and subtitle generation.

With Vireel, you can start from an imported video or a YouTube link, let the AI identify the best moments to create your Reels, and then customize each creation before sharing it. The subtitle feature allows you to generate, style, and translate your video text, with additional options like eye contact tracking and AI video effects.

Vireel thus offers a comprehensive solution to transform, customize, and share your videos, while keeping a simple workflow from a single platform.
landing.faq4: How do I turn a long video into a Reel?
landing.faq4Desc:
Import your video into Vireel or simply paste a YouTube link, then start creating your Reel. The AI analyzes your content to identify the most interesting moments and generates short clips in 9:16 vertical format.

You can then adjust each Reel, customize its style, add subtitles or effects, and share your creation directly on your social media channels.
landing.faq5: How does Vireel identify the best moments of a video?
landing.faq5Desc:
Vireel uses AI to analyze your video and identify the most interesting and relevant passages for creating short content. The analysis takes the video content into account to select the moments with the highest potential to capture your audience's attention.

Once the moments are selected, Vireel transforms them into Reels in 9:16 vertical format. You can then customize each clip, adjust its style, add subtitles or effects, and share it on your social media channels.
landing.faq6: Can Vireel translate subtitles into other languages?
landing.faq6Desc:
Yes. Vireel allows you to easily translate your subtitle text into different languages to adapt your videos for an international audience. You can then customize their style and appearance before sharing your content on your social media channels.

Voice translation and video dubbing will be offered in an upcoming version of Vireel.
landing.faq7: How does smart vertical reframing work?
landing.faq7Desc:
Vireel automatically adapts your horizontal videos into 9:16 vertical format, ideal for Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts. Smart reframing tracks the main subject on screen to keep it properly framed throughout the video.

The result is a smooth and natural framing, without having to manually reposition the video frame by frame. You can then adjust the rendering and customize your Reel before sharing it on your social media channels.
landing.faq8: On which social networks can I share my videos?
landing.faq8Desc: You can share your videos directly to several popular social networks, such as Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and Facebook. Vireel makes it easy to share your creations to maximize their visibility and engagement with your audience.
landing.faq9: Are my videos stored on Vireel?
landing.faq9Desc: Yes. Your videos and creations are stored on Vireel, with dedicated storage space depending on your subscription plan. You can manage your videos, access your past creations, and share them directly from the platform. Secure storage allows you to keep your content and find it easily for later reuse or editing.
landing.faq10: Can I cancel my subscription at any time?
landing.faq10Desc: Yes. You can cancel your subscription at any time from your account settings. The cancellation will take effect at the end of the current billing period, and you will continue to have access to your plan's features until that date.
landing.faq11: Does Vireel use my videos to train its AI?
landing.faq11Desc: No. Your videos are not used to train Vireel's AI models. Your content remains dedicated solely to the creation and processing of videos you produce using the platform.
landing.faq12: Can I cancel my subscription at any time?
landing.faq12Desc: Yes. You can cancel your subscription at any time from your account management. Your access remains available until the end of the already paid subscription period.
landing.faq13: What happens if I exceed my credits?
landing.faq13Desc: When you have used all the credits included in your subscription, features requiring credits become unavailable until your plan renews or until additional credits are added, depending on the options offered by your subscription.
landing.faq14: Can I change plans during my subscription?
landing.faq14Desc: Yes. You can upgrade or change your subscription when your needs change. Upgrade to a higher plan to benefit from more credits, storage, and creation capacity.
landing.faq15: Can I use Vireel for commercial videos?
landing.faq15Desc: Yes. You can use Vireel to create content for your business activities, brands, marketing campaigns, or clients. However, you must hold the necessary rights to the videos and content you use.
landing.faq16: What is the difference between Reel creation and subtitles?
landing.faq16Desc:
Reel creation allows you to transform a long video into multiple short clips. Vireel analyzes the content to identify the most interesting moments, then generates videos adapted to vertical format.

The Subtitles feature allows you to add synchronized subtitles to your videos, customize their style, and translate their text into different languages.

Both features can be used separately or combined to create ready-to-share short content.
landing.faq17: How to contact the Vireel team?
landing.faq17Desc:
Our team is available to answer your questions and assist you with using Vireel. You can contact us directly via WhatsApp (+33 658 83 58 97) or by email (contact@vireel.co) for any questions regarding your account, subscription, or platform features.

We will get back to you as soon as possible.
